source_text: I can’t leave Carol and Heather. I told them I’d help with the garden.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I can’t leave Carol and Heather. I told them I’d help with the garden.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I can’t leave Carol and Heather. I told them I’d help with the garden."

translation: Nie mogę zostawić Carol i Heather. Obiecałem, że pomogę im w ogrodzie.

source_text: I can’t leave in my swim trunks. I should change back into my normal clothes.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I can’t leave in my swim trunks. I should change back into my normal clothes.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I can’t leave in my swim trunks. I should change back into my normal clothes."

translation: Nie mogę wyjść w samych kąpielówkach. Powinienem przebrać się w zwykłe ubranie.

source_text: I shouldn’t go inside. I need to let things cool off.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I shouldn’t go inside. I need to let things cool off.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I shouldn’t go inside. I need to let things cool off."

translation: Nie powinienem wchodzić do środka. Muszę dać sprawom trochę ostygnąć.

source_text: Where were you thinking about going, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Where were you thinking about going, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Where were you thinking about going, 1Hero?"

translation: Dokąd chciałeś iść, 1Hero?

source_text: Let’s go to the strip over by the apartments.

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.Let’s go to the strip over by the apartments.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.Let’s go to the strip over by the apartments."

translation: Chodźmy do pasażu handlowego przy apartamentach.

source_text: You want to eat at Dick's?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.You want to eat at Dick's?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.You want to eat at Dick's?"

translation: Chcesz zjeść w Dick’s?

source_text: That’s what I was thinking. Hannah can get more food there.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.That’s what I was thinking. Hannah can get more food there.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.That’s what I was thinking. Hannah can get more food there."

translation: Właśnie o tym myślałem. Hannah może tam dostać więcej jedzenia.

source_text: Yeah, let’s go check it out.

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Yeah, let’s go check it out.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Yeah, let’s go check it out."

translation: Tak, chodźmy zobaczyć.

source_text: Chloe. I thought you might be staying at the church.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Chloe. I thought you might be staying at the church.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Chloe. I thought you might be staying at the church."

translation: Chloe. Myślałem, że zostaniesz w kościele.

source_text: I might go back later.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.I might go back later.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.I might go back later."

translation: Może później tam wrócę.

source_text: Go back? How much time are you planning to spend at that place?

structure.raw_value: HnAnDe.Go back? How much time are you planning to spend at that place?
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDe.Go back? How much time are you planning to spend at that place?"

translation: Wrócić? Ile czasu zamierzasz tam spędzać?

source_text: I don’t know. Am I missing something by being there?

structure.raw_value: ChBaDe.I don’t know. Am I missing something by being there?
structure.script_literal: "ChBaDe.I don’t know. Am I missing something by being there?"

translation: Nie wiem. Coś mnie omija, kiedy tam jestem?

source_text: Well… Not right now. But let’s change that.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.Well… Not right now. But let’s change that.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.Well… Not right now. But let’s change that."

translation: Cóż… Na razie nie. Ale możemy to zmienić.

source_text: I’d love to see the forest. It’s beautiful right now.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I’d love to see the forest. It’s beautiful right now.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I’d love to see the forest. It’s beautiful right now."

translation: Chętnie zobaczyłabym las. Teraz jest tam pięknie.

source_text: A fine idea, Chloe, but 1Hero can’t come. He doesn’t have time now that he has a new girlfriend.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.A fine idea, Chloe, but 1Hero can’t come. He doesn’t have time now that he has a new girlfriend.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.A fine idea, Chloe, but 1Hero can’t come. He doesn’t have time now that he has a new girlfriend."

translation: Świetny pomysł, Chloe, ale 1Hero nie może iść. Nie ma teraz czasu, bo ma nową dziewczynę.

source_text: Will you stop saying that, Hannah? I don’t have a girlfriend.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Will you stop saying that, Hannah? I don’t have a girlfriend.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Will you stop saying that, Hannah? I don’t have a girlfriend."

translation: Przestaniesz tak mówić, Hannah? Nie mam dziewczyny.

source_text: Fuck buddy. Whatever you want to call it.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.Fuck buddy. Whatever you want to call it.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.Fuck buddy. Whatever you want to call it."

translation: Koleżanka do seksu. Jak zwał, tak zwał.

source_text: Don’t be mean to 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.Don’t be mean to 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.Don’t be mean to 1Hero."

translation: Nie bądź niemiła dla 1Hero.

source_text: I’m not being mean. I’m simply stating the obvious.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I’m not being mean. I’m simply stating the obvious.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I’m not being mean. I’m simply stating the obvious."

translation: Nie jestem niemiła. Po prostu mówię, jak jest.

source_text: If you want to go into the forest, you’re not going to get far. That place is overgrown.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If you want to go into the forest, you’re not going to get far. That place is overgrown.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If you want to go into the forest, you’re not going to get far. That place is overgrown."

translation: Jeśli chcecie iść do lasu, daleko nie zajdziecie. Wszystko zarosło.

source_text: Best wait till fall. Then the trails open up.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Best wait till fall. Then the trails open up.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Best wait till fall. Then the trails open up."

translation: Lepiej poczekać do jesieni. Wtedy ścieżki będą dostępne.

source_text: We don’t have to go far. I just think it would be nice to spend some time together, just the three of us.

structure.raw_value: ChHaEx.We don’t have to go far. I just think it would be nice to spend some time together, just the three of us.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaEx.We don’t have to go far. I just think it would be nice to spend some time together, just the three of us."

translation: Nie musimy iść daleko. Po prostu miło byłoby spędzić trochę czasu razem, we trójkę.

source_text: What do ya say, 1Hero? Care to accompany us girls in Casula Forest?

structure.raw_value: HnFlOp.What do ya say, 1Hero? Care to accompany us girls in Casula Forest?
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOp.What do ya say, 1Hero? Care to accompany us girls in Casula Forest?"

translation: Co ty na to, 1Hero? Masz ochotę wybrać się z nami do lasu Casula?

source_text: We’ll need to find a way to cut through the brush if we’re going to go far.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We’ll need to find a way to cut through the brush if we’re going to go far.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We’ll need to find a way to cut through the brush if we’re going to go far."

translation: Jeśli chcemy iść daleko, musimy znaleźć sposób, żeby przedrzeć się przez zarośla.

source_text: I’m sure you can figure it out…

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp.I’m sure you can figure it out…
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp.I’m sure you can figure it out…"

translation: Na pewno coś wymyślisz…

source_text: Come on, Chloe. Let’s go.

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Come on, Chloe. Let’s go.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Come on, Chloe. Let’s go."

translation: Chodź, Chloe. Idziemy.

source_text: You’re coming?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.You’re coming?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.You’re coming?"

translation: Idziesz z nami?

source_text: I’ll meet you there in a bit.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll meet you there in a bit.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll meet you there in a bit."

translation: Dołączę do was za chwilę.

source_text: Cool. See ya there.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp.Cool. See ya there.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOp.Cool. See ya there."

translation: Super. Do zobaczenia na miejscu.

source_text: I hope Hannah doesn’t try to go too far and get lost.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I hope Hannah doesn’t try to go too far and get lost.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I hope Hannah doesn’t try to go too far and get lost."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Hannah nie zapuści się za daleko i się nie zgubi.

source_text: I didn’t expect to see you this morning.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.I didn’t expect to see you this morning.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.I didn’t expect to see you this morning."

translation: Nie spodziewałem się, że cię dziś rano zobaczę.

source_text: I’m just checking in. There was a report of someone peeking into people’s houses.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m just checking in. There was a report of someone peeking into people’s houses.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m just checking in. There was a report of someone peeking into people’s houses."

translation: Wpadłem tylko sprawdzić, co u was. Zgłoszono, że ktoś zagląda do cudzych domów.

source_text: Oh, my. Thieves?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Oh, my. Thieves?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Oh, my. Thieves?"

translation: Ojej. Złodzieje?

source_text: Voyeurs.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Voyeurs.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Voyeurs."

translation: Podglądacze.

source_text: Haha. Now, that’s something new.

structure.raw_value: HeFlDeNo3.Haha. Now, that’s something new.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlDeNo3.Haha. Now, that’s something new."

translation: Ha, ha. Tego jeszcze nie było.

source_text: Where’s Chloe? Gone to Hannah’s?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Where’s Chloe? Gone to Hannah’s?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Where’s Chloe? Gone to Hannah’s?"

translation: Gdzie Chloe? Poszła do Hannah?

source_text: No, she’s still inside. I’m sure she’d love a visit.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx.No, she’s still inside. I’m sure she’d love a visit.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx.No, she’s still inside. I’m sure she’d love a visit."

translation: Nie, nadal jest w środku. Na pewno ucieszy się z twojej wizyty.

source_text: Thanks for the heads up, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Thanks for the heads up, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Thanks for the heads up, 1Hero."

translation: Dzięki za ostrzeżenie, 1Hero.

source_text: Thanks for warning me about the voyeur. I’ll let you know if I see anyone suspicious.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Thanks for warning me about the voyeur. I’ll let you know if I see anyone suspicious.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Thanks for warning me about the voyeur. I’ll let you know if I see anyone suspicious."

translation: Dziękuję, że ostrzegłeś mnie przed podglądaczem. Dam ci znać, jeśli zobaczę kogoś podejrzanego.

source_text: You can’t lie to me! I saw you!

structure.raw_value: ChMaAgNo1.You can’t lie to me! I saw you!
structure.script_literal: "ChMaAgNo1.You can’t lie to me! I saw you!"

translation: Nie okłamiesz mnie! Widziałam cię!

source_text: Don’t hurt me!

structure.raw_value: LaWoCl^.Don’t hurt me!
structure.script_literal: "LaWoCl^.Don’t hurt me!"

translation: Nie rób mi krzywdy!

source_text: Chloe!? Larry!?

structure.raw_value: McShCl.Chloe!? Larry!?
structure.script_literal: "McShCl.Chloe!? Larry!?"

translation: Chloe!? Larry!?

source_text: You know this pervert?

structure.raw_value: ChAnEx.You know this pervert?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnEx.You know this pervert?"

translation: Znasz tego zboczeńca?

source_text: 1Hero! I was just delivering the paper!

structure.raw_value: LaWoCl^.1Hero! I was just delivering the paper!
structure.script_literal: "LaWoCl^.1Hero! I was just delivering the paper!"

translation: 1Hero! Ja tylko roznosiłem gazety!

source_text: Then where are your papers!?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Then where are your papers!?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Then where are your papers!?"

translation: To gdzie masz te gazety!?

source_text: What the hell, Larry? Are you spying on Chloe?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.What the hell, Larry? Are you spying on Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.What the hell, Larry? Are you spying on Chloe?"

translation: Co jest, do cholery, Larry? Podglądasz Chloe?

source_text: I thought you were delivering newspapers. Your story is changing now?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.I thought you were delivering newspapers. Your story is changing now?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.I thought you were delivering newspapers. Your story is changing now?"

translation: Myślałam, że roznosisz gazety. Teraz zmieniasz wersję?

source_text: Uh… Uh… I got to go!

structure.raw_value: LaShCl^.Uh… Uh… I got to go!
structure.script_literal: "LaShCl^.Uh… Uh… I got to go!"

translation: Eee… Ja… Muszę już iść!

source_text: Who the hell was that creep?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Who the hell was that creep?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Who the hell was that creep?"

translation: Co to był za oblech?

source_text: He must be the voyeur that the police are looking for.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.He must be the voyeur that the police are looking for.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.He must be the voyeur that the police are looking for."

translation: To pewnie ten podglądacz, którego szuka policja.

source_text: You know who he is?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.You know who he is?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.You know who he is?"

translation: Wiesz, kim on jest?

source_text: I met him at the gym. He’s always hanging out there.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I met him at the gym. He’s always hanging out there.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I met him at the gym. He’s always hanging out there."

translation: Poznałam go na siłowni. Ciągle tam przesiaduje.

source_text: Chloe? You’re still here?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.Chloe? You’re still here?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.Chloe? You’re still here?"

translation: Chloe? Nadal tu jesteś?

source_text: Am I getting in your way?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Am I getting in your way?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Am I getting in your way?"

translation: Przeszkadzam ci?

source_text: Come on, baby. Don’t be mad.

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.Come on, baby. Don’t be mad.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.Come on, baby. Don’t be mad."

translation: No chodź, kochanie. Nie gniewaj się.

source_text: We saw the pervert.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We saw the pervert.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We saw the pervert."

translation: Widzieliśmy tego zboczeńca.

source_text: What? The voyeur?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.What? The voyeur?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.What? The voyeur?"

translation: Co? Tego podglądacza?

source_text: I know who he is. He’s a gym rat…

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I know who he is. He’s a gym rat…
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I know who he is. He’s a gym rat…"

translation: Wiem, kim jest. To bywalec siłowni…

source_text: I’ll take care of him.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’ll take care of him.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’ll take care of him."

translation: Zajmę się nim.

source_text: Oh, dear. I wonder how long he’s been peeping in windows.

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Oh, dear. I wonder how long he’s been peeping in windows.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Oh, dear. I wonder how long he’s been peeping in windows."

translation: Ojej. Ciekawe, od jak dawna zagląda ludziom w okna.

source_text: Maybe you shouldn’t sunbathe nude.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Maybe you shouldn’t sunbathe nude.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Maybe you shouldn’t sunbathe nude."

translation: Może nie powinnaś opalać się nago.

source_text: Some risks are worth taking.

structure.raw_value: HeFlDe.Some risks are worth taking.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlDe.Some risks are worth taking."

translation: Niektóre ryzyko warto podjąć.

source_text: Come on, Heather.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Come on, Heather.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Come on, Heather."

translation: Chodź, Heather.

source_text: Catch ya later. I’m going to go catch up with Chloe.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Catch ya later. I’m going to go catch up with Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Catch ya later. I’m going to go catch up with Chloe."

translation: Na razie. Pójdę nadrobić zaległości z Chloe.

source_text: I’ll need some grease and a rubber boot if I’m going to fix the axle.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.I’ll need some grease and a rubber boot if I’m going to fix the axle.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.I’ll need some grease and a rubber boot if I’m going to fix the axle."

translation: Do naprawy osi potrzebuję smaru i gumowej osłony przegubu.

source_text: I’ve got some grease and also a rubber boot.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve got some grease and also a rubber boot.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve got some grease and also a rubber boot."

translation: Mam smar i gumową osłonę przegubu.

source_text: It’ll take a while to fix it.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.It’ll take a while to fix it.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.It’ll take a while to fix it."

translation: Naprawa trochę potrwa.

source_text: I hear some bad weather is on the way.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.I hear some bad weather is on the way.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.I hear some bad weather is on the way."

translation: Słyszałam, że nadciąga paskudna pogoda.

source_text: 1Hero, care to offer some muscles? It’ll make this fix faster.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.1Hero, care to offer some muscles? It’ll make this fix faster.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.1Hero, care to offer some muscles? It’ll make this fix faster."

translation: 1Hero, pomożesz mi trochę? Dzięki temu szybciej to naprawimy.

source_text: I can’t stay long. I have to get to the church.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I can’t stay long. I have to get to the church.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I can’t stay long. I have to get to the church."

translation: Nie mogę zostać długo. Muszę iść do kościoła.

source_text: Don’t worry. It won't be long.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Don’t worry. It won't be long.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Don’t worry. It won't be long."

translation: Nie martw się. To nie potrwa długo.

source_text: Okay, Carol. I can help.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Okay, Carol. I can help.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Okay, Carol. I can help."

translation: Dobrze, Carol. Pomogę.

source_text: I’ll make us some drinks for when you're finished.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.I’ll make us some drinks for when you're finished.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.I’ll make us some drinks for when you're finished."

translation: Przygotuję nam coś do picia, jak skończycie.

source_text: Sounds great!

structure.raw_value: CaHaOp.Sounds great!
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOp.Sounds great!"

translation: Świetnie!

source_text: Alright, 1Hero. Let’s get to work.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Alright, 1Hero. Let’s get to work.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Alright, 1Hero. Let’s get to work."

translation: No dobrze, 1Hero. Do roboty.

source_text: Just let me know what to do.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just let me know what to do.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just let me know what to do."

translation: Po prostu powiedz, co mam robić.

source_text: You’ve never fixed a broken axle before?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You’ve never fixed a broken axle before?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You’ve never fixed a broken axle before?"

translation: Nigdy wcześniej nie naprawiałeś uszkodzonej osi?

source_text: Well… Not really.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Well… Not really.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Well… Not really."

translation: Cóż… Niezbyt.

source_text: Oh, 1Hero. You’ve got some learnin’ to do.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Oh, 1Hero. You’ve got some learnin’ to do.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Oh, 1Hero. You’ve got some learnin’ to do."

translation: Oj, 1Hero. Jeszcze sporo musisz się nauczyć.

source_text: What are you two doing!? Are you crazy!?

structure.raw_value: HeShCl.What are you two doing!? Are you crazy!?
structure.script_literal: "HeShCl.What are you two doing!? Are you crazy!?"

translation: Co wy dwoje wyprawiacie!? Oszaleliście!?

source_text: No one’s watchin’. We finished in a hurry.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx>.No one’s watchin’. We finished in a hurry.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx>.No one’s watchin’. We finished in a hurry."

translation: Nikt nie patrzy. Szybko skończyliśmy.

source_text: Did you even fix the truck?

structure.raw_value: HeShCl.Did you even fix the truck?
structure.script_literal: "HeShCl.Did you even fix the truck?"

translation: W ogóle naprawiliście ciężarówkę?

source_text: Of course! We’re just… celebrating.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx>.Of course! We’re just… celebrating.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx>.Of course! We’re just… celebrating."

translation: Oczywiście! Po prostu… świętujemy.

source_text: Carol! I had no idea…

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Carol! I had no idea…
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Carol! I had no idea…"

translation: Carol! Nie miałem pojęcia…

source_text: Heather… I don’t know what to say.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Heather… I don’t know what to say.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Heather… I don’t know what to say."

translation: Heather… Nie wiem, co powiedzieć.

source_text: I can’t believe you, 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.I can’t believe you, 1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.I can’t believe you, 1Hero…"

translation: Nie wierzę, że to zrobiłeś, 1Hero…

source_text: I just… We just… I…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I just… We just… I…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I just… We just… I…"

translation: Ja tylko… My tylko… Ja…

source_text: Now, now, Heather. No need to get jealous.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe>.Now, now, Heather. No need to get jealous.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe>.Now, now, Heather. No need to get jealous."

translation: Spokojnie, Heather. Nie ma co zazdrościć.

source_text: Jealous!? What the hell are you saying?

structure.raw_value: HeAnOp.Jealous!? What the hell are you saying?
structure.script_literal: "HeAnOp.Jealous!? What the hell are you saying?"

translation: Zazdrościć!? O czym ty, do cholery, mówisz?

source_text: God damn it. What the hell did we do?

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.God damn it. What the hell did we do?
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.God damn it. What the hell did we do?"

translation: Cholera jasna. Co myśmy narobili?

source_text: Calm down, baby. She’s just mad that you’re not giving her any sugar.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Calm down, baby. She’s just mad that you’re not giving her any sugar.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Calm down, baby. She’s just mad that you’re not giving her any sugar."

translation: Spokojnie, kochanie. Jest tylko zła, bo nie dajesz jej odrobiny przyjemności.

source_text: Fuck. How did this happen?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Fuck. How did this happen?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Fuck. How did this happen?"

translation: Kurwa. Jak do tego doszło?

source_text: You go get to the church. I’ll handle Heather.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.You go get to the church. I’ll handle Heather.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.You go get to the church. I’ll handle Heather."

translation: Idź do kościoła. Ja zajmę się Heather.

source_text: What are you going to say?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What are you going to say?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What are you going to say?"

translation: Co jej powiesz?

source_text: I’m gonna tell her that she’s invited to our little party.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.I’m gonna tell her that she’s invited to our little party.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.I’m gonna tell her that she’s invited to our little party."

translation: Powiem jej, że jest zaproszona na naszą małą imprezkę.

source_text: This has gone too far… Things are getting out of control.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.This has gone too far… Things are getting out of control.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.This has gone too far… Things are getting out of control."

translation: Zaszło to za daleko… Wymknęło się spod kontroli.

source_text: You’re driving her crazy. You know that, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You’re driving her crazy. You know that, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You’re driving her crazy. You know that, 1Hero?"

translation: Doprowadzasz ją do szaleństwa, wiesz o tym, 1Hero?

source_text: Trust me, 1Hero. I’ll fix this.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Trust me, 1Hero. I’ll fix this.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Trust me, 1Hero. I’ll fix this."

translation: Zaufaj mi, 1Hero. Naprawię to.

source_text: You have no idea what Heather means to me.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You have no idea what Heather means to me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You have no idea what Heather means to me."

translation: Nie masz pojęcia, ile Heather dla mnie znaczy.

source_text: And what the hell do I mean to you?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.And what the hell do I mean to you?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.And what the hell do I mean to you?"

translation: A co ja, do cholery, dla ciebie znaczę?

source_text: Hey! It’s not like that… It’s just… You weren’t always around…

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Hey! It’s not like that… It’s just… You weren’t always around…
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Hey! It’s not like that… It’s just… You weren’t always around…"

translation: Hej! To nie tak… Po prostu… Nie zawsze byłaś obok…

source_text: Heather changed my damned diaper for Christ’s sake.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Heather changed my damned diaper for Christ’s sake.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Heather changed my damned diaper for Christ’s sake."

translation: Na litość boską, Heather zmieniała mi pieluchy.

source_text: She’s got a good eighteen years on ya. What do you expect?

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.She’s got a good eighteen years on ya. What do you expect?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.She’s got a good eighteen years on ya. What do you expect?"

translation: Jest od ciebie starsza o dobre osiemnaście lat. Czego się spodziewasz?

source_text: How do you not see it? What if Chloe wanted to fool around with you?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.How do you not see it? What if Chloe wanted to fool around with you?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.How do you not see it? What if Chloe wanted to fool around with you?"

translation: Jak możesz tego nie widzieć? A gdyby Chloe chciała się z tobą zabawić?

source_text: I’d let her.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.I’d let her.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.I’d let her."

translation: Pozwoliłbym jej.

source_text: Carol!

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Carol!
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Carol!"

translation: Carol!

source_text: Stop being such a prude.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Stop being such a prude.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Stop being such a prude."

translation: Przestań być taką pruderyjną świętoszką.

source_text: I’m not a prude! I’m just sane.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m not a prude! I’m just sane.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m not a prude! I’m just sane."

translation: Nie jestem pruderyjna! Po prostu zachowałam zdrowy rozsądek.

source_text: No need to be callin’ names.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.No need to be callin’ names.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.No need to be callin’ names."

translation: Nie ma co się wyzywać.

source_text: I’m sorry, Carol. But, will you please help me out here?

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I’m sorry, Carol. But, will you please help me out here?
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I’m sorry, Carol. But, will you please help me out here?"

translation: Przepraszam, Carol. Ale czy możesz mi pomóc?

source_text: Alright. I get it. I’ll see what I can do.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Alright. I get it. I’ll see what I can do.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Alright. I get it. I’ll see what I can do."

translation: Dobrze. Rozumiem. Zobaczę, co da się zrobić.

source_text: Thank you, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Thank you, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Thank you, Carol."

translation: Dziękuję, Carol.

source_text: Get on out of here. I’ve got this.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Get on out of here. I’ve got this.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Get on out of here. I’ve got this."

translation: No już, zmykaj. Poradzę sobie.

source_text: Oh, boy. Where the hell did all this drama come from?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl^.Oh, boy. Where the hell did all this drama come from?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl^.Oh, boy. Where the hell did all this drama come from?"

translation: O rany. Skąd się wzięło całe to zamieszanie?

source_text: Yep. It’s the axle.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.Yep. It’s the axle.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.Yep. It’s the axle."

translation: Tak. To oś.

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: Something wrong with the truck?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Something wrong with the truck?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Something wrong with the truck?"

translation: Coś nie tak z ciężarówką?

source_text: I was just visiting Heather before heading home and the damn axle popped. I think this truck is finally getting too old.

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.I was just visiting Heather before heading home and the damn axle popped. I think this truck is finally getting too old.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.I was just visiting Heather before heading home and the damn axle popped. I think this truck is finally getting too old."

translation: Odwiedzałem Heather przed powrotem do domu, kiedy ta przeklęta oś pękła. Chyba ta ciężarówka w końcu się zestarzała.

source_text: Nonsense. It’s been in your family for a long time, but it’s a looker.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.Nonsense. It’s been in your family for a long time, but it’s a looker.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Nonsense. It’s been in your family for a long time, but it’s a looker."

translation: Daj spokój. Jest w waszej rodzinie od dawna, ale nadal świetnie się prezentuje.

source_text: They sure don’t make them like they used to.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.They sure don’t make them like they used to.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.They sure don’t make them like they used to."

translation: Już takich nie produkują.

source_text: The boot disintegrated and the grease got everywhere.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.The boot disintegrated and the grease got everywhere.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.The boot disintegrated and the grease got everywhere."

translation: Osłona przegubu się rozpadła, a smar rozpryskał się wszędzie.

source_text: I can’t risk driving it until I fix the boot.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.I can’t risk driving it until I fix the boot.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.I can’t risk driving it until I fix the boot."

translation: Nie mogę ryzykować jazdy, dopóki nie naprawię osłony.

source_text: You can grab some grease from the store, but I don’t know where you’d find a boot…

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.You can grab some grease from the store, but I don’t know where you’d find a boot…
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.You can grab some grease from the store, but I don’t know where you’d find a boot…"

translation: Smar możesz kupić w sklepie, ale nie wiem, skąd weźmiesz osłonę…

source_text: Maybe some old junker car would have one I could borrow.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Maybe some old junker car would have one I could borrow.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Maybe some old junker car would have one I could borrow."

translation: Może znajdę taką w jakimś starym wraku samochodu.

source_text: I know a place that has some junker cars. I’ll see if I can help you out.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I know a place that has some junker cars. I’ll see if I can help you out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I know a place that has some junker cars. I’ll see if I can help you out."

translation: Znam miejsce, gdzie stoją stare wraki. Zobaczę, czy uda mi się pomóc.

source_text: Such a helpful young man.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Such a helpful young man.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Such a helpful young man."

translation: Jaki pomocny młody człowiek.

source_text: I’m not much of a car girl, but I sure do like Carol’s blue truck. I hope she fixes it.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.I’m not much of a car girl, but I sure do like Carol’s blue truck. I hope she fixes it.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.I’m not much of a car girl, but I sure do like Carol’s blue truck. I hope she fixes it."

translation: Nie znam się za bardzo na samochodach, ale bardzo lubię niebieską ciężarówkę Carol. Mam nadzieję, że ją naprawi.

source_text: It’s a beauty for sure. I’m sure we can fix it.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s a beauty for sure. I’m sure we can fix it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s a beauty for sure. I’m sure we can fix it."

translation: To prawdziwe cacko. Na pewno uda nam się ją naprawić.

source_text: 1Hero. Where is Chloe?

structure.raw_value: HnBaEx.1Hero. Where is Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "HnBaEx.1Hero. Where is Chloe?"

translation: 1Hero. Gdzie jest Chloe?

source_text: She’s inside with Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’s inside with Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’s inside with Judy."

translation: Jest w środku z Judy.

source_text: She’s still hanging out with the nun?

structure.raw_value: HnShOp.She’s still hanging out with the nun?
structure.script_literal: "HnShOp.She’s still hanging out with the nun?"

translation: Nadal spędza czas z zakonnicą?

source_text: She’s coming to dinner with us tonight.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.She’s coming to dinner with us tonight.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.She’s coming to dinner with us tonight."

translation: Przyjdzie dziś z nami na kolację.

source_text: No way! A nun at dinner! That’s going to be bonkers!

structure.raw_value: HnShAgNo1.No way! A nun at dinner! That’s going to be bonkers!
structure.script_literal: "HnShAgNo1.No way! A nun at dinner! That’s going to be bonkers!"

translation: Nie ma mowy! Zakonnica na kolacji! Ale będzie jazda!

source_text: She’ll be fine as long as you behave yourself.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’ll be fine as long as you behave yourself.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’ll be fine as long as you behave yourself."

translation: Wszystko będzie dobrze, jeśli będziesz się grzecznie zachowywać.

source_text: I ain’t holding back for a nun. That girl could use some toughening up.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I ain’t holding back for a nun. That girl could use some toughening up.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I ain’t holding back for a nun. That girl could use some toughening up."

translation: Nie będę się hamować przy zakonnicy. Powinna się trochę zahartować.

source_text: Hannah! I was just about to call you.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Hannah! I was just about to call you.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Hannah! I was just about to call you."

translation: Hannah! Właśnie miałam do ciebie dzwonić.

source_text: Hello, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Hello, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Hello, Hannah."

translation: Cześć, Hannah.

source_text: Howdy, Sister. 1Hero here tells me you want to go out on the town with us.

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx^.Howdy, Sister. 1Hero here tells me you want to go out on the town with us.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx^.Howdy, Sister. 1Hero here tells me you want to go out on the town with us."

translation: Witaj, siostro. 1Hero mówi, że chcesz wyjść z nami na miasto.

source_text: Oh, my. I’d love to eat supper with you. But nothing too crazy.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, my. I’d love to eat supper with you. But nothing too crazy.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, my. I’d love to eat supper with you. But nothing too crazy."

translation: Ojej. Chętnie zjem z wami kolację. Tylko bez żadnych szaleństw.

source_text: Don’t worry, Sister. No more kickball.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx^.Don’t worry, Sister. No more kickball.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx^.Don’t worry, Sister. No more kickball."

translation: Spokojnie, siostro. Koniec z grą w zbijaka.

source_text: Haha. Oh, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOpNo3.Haha. Oh, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOpNo3.Haha. Oh, Hannah. "

translation: Ha, ha. Och, Hannah.

source_text: That’s a lovely outfit you have, Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.That’s a lovely outfit you have, Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.That’s a lovely outfit you have, Sister Judy."

translation: Ma siostra śliczny strój, siostro Judy.

source_text: It’s Chloe’s. She was nice enough to lend it to me.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.It’s Chloe’s. She was nice enough to lend it to me.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.It’s Chloe’s. She was nice enough to lend it to me."

translation: Jest Chloe. Była tak miła, że mi go pożyczyła.

source_text: It looks great on her! Don’t you think so, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChHaEx.It looks great on her! Don’t you think so, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChHaEx.It looks great on her! Don’t you think so, 1Hero?"

translation: Świetnie na niej leży! Nie uważasz, 1Hero?

source_text: When are we eating? I’m starving!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx^.When are we eating? I’m starving!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx^.When are we eating? I’m starving!"

translation: Kiedy jemy? Umieram z głodu!

source_text: How about we all meet at Dick’s at seven o’clock?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.How about we all meet at Dick’s at seven o’clock?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.How about we all meet at Dick’s at seven o’clock?"

translation: Może spotkamy się wszyscy u Dicka o siódmej?

source_text: Sure. That’ll work.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Sure. That’ll work.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Sure. That’ll work."

translation: Jasne. Pasuje.

source_text: I’m looking forward to it.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.I’m looking forward to it.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.I’m looking forward to it."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać.

source_text: We should get the banana muffins! You’d love them, Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.We should get the banana muffins! You’d love them, Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.We should get the banana muffins! You’d love them, Sister Judy."

translation: Weźmy muffinki bananowe! Na pewno by ci smakowały, siostro Judy.

source_text: I don’t know if sweets are good for my teeth.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I don’t know if sweets are good for my teeth.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I don’t know if sweets are good for my teeth."

translation: Nie wiem, czy słodycze są dobre dla moich zębów.

source_text: That’s why God made toothbrushes, silly!

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx^.That’s why God made toothbrushes, silly!
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx^.That’s why God made toothbrushes, silly!"

translation: Właśnie po to Bóg stworzył szczoteczki do zębów, głuptasie!

source_text: Hannah!

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Hannah!
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Hannah!"

translation: Hannah!

source_text: It’ll be fine, Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.It’ll be fine, Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.It’ll be fine, Sister Judy."

translation: Nic się nie stanie, siostro Judy.

source_text: Maybe I should stop by the church on the way over.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Maybe I should stop by the church on the way over.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Maybe I should stop by the church on the way over."

translation: Może po drodze wstąpię do kościoła.

source_text: That’s way outta the way!

structure.raw_value: HnShOp^.That’s way outta the way!
structure.script_literal: "HnShOp^.That’s way outta the way! "

translation: To zupełnie nie po drodze!

source_text: I’d like to get my toothbrush.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I’d like to get my toothbrush.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I’d like to get my toothbrush."

translation: Chciałabym zabrać swoją szczoteczkę do zębów.

source_text: I’ve got a few things to do before dinner. Maybe I can stop by and grab it for you.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve got a few things to do before dinner. Maybe I can stop by and grab it for you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve got a few things to do before dinner. Maybe I can stop by and grab it for you."

translation: Mam kilka spraw do załatwienia przed kolacją. Może wstąpię po nią i ci ją przyniosę.

source_text: Really? You’re so kind.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Really? You’re so kind.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Really? You’re so kind."

translation: Naprawdę? Jesteś taki miły.

source_text: Of course. I’m always happy to help.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Of course. I’m always happy to help.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Of course. I’m always happy to help."

translation: Oczywiście. Zawsze chętnie pomogę.

source_text: Go get her the damned toothbrush so she can eat the muffin.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Go get her the damned toothbrush so she can eat the muffin.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Go get her the damned toothbrush so she can eat the muffin."

translation: Idź po tę przeklętą szczoteczkę, żeby mogła zjeść muffinkę.

source_text: Hannah, don’t be so crude in front of Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.Hannah, don’t be so crude in front of Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.Hannah, don’t be so crude in front of Sister Judy."

translation: Hannah, nie bądź taka wulgarna przy siostrze Judy.

source_text: I’m sorry, Sister. I’ve got a foul mouth sometimes.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx^.I’m sorry, Sister. I’ve got a foul mouth sometimes.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx^.I’m sorry, Sister. I’ve got a foul mouth sometimes."

translation: Przepraszam, siostro. Czasem mam niewyparzony język.

source_text: It’s quite alright. I don’t want to be a burden.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.It’s quite alright. I don’t want to be a burden.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.It’s quite alright. I don’t want to be a burden."

translation: Nic nie szkodzi. Nie chcę być ciężarem.

source_text: You’re not a burden. We love being with you.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.You’re not a burden. We love being with you.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.You’re not a burden. We love being with you."

translation: Nie jesteś ciężarem. Lubimy spędzać z tobą czas.

source_text: You just need to thicken that skin of yours.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx^.You just need to thicken that skin of yours.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx^.You just need to thicken that skin of yours."

translation: Musisz tylko nabrać trochę grubszej skóry.

source_text: Hannah!

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.Hannah!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.Hannah!"

translation: Hannah!

source_text: Hannah!

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Hannah!
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Hannah!"

translation: Hannah!

source_text: I appreciate your openness, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I appreciate your openness, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I appreciate your openness, Hannah."

translation: Doceniam twoją szczerość, Hannah.

source_text: Thank you, Sister!

structure.raw_value: HnFlDe^.Thank you, Sister!
structure.script_literal: "HnFlDe^.Thank you, Sister!"

translation: Dziękuję, siostro!

source_text: See you at seven o’clock at Dick’s, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.See you at seven o’clock at Dick’s, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.See you at seven o’clock at Dick’s, 1Hero."

translation: Do zobaczenia o siódmej u Dicka, 1Hero.

source_text: Can we go inside now? I gotta pee.

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx^.Can we go inside now? I gotta pee.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx^.Can we go inside now? I gotta pee."

translation: Możemy już wejść? Muszę siku.

source_text: Thank you, 1Hero. I’m sorry if I spoiled your fun.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.Thank you, 1Hero. I’m sorry if I spoiled your fun.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.Thank you, 1Hero. I’m sorry if I spoiled your fun."

translation: Dziękuję, 1Hero. Przepraszam, jeśli popsułam ci zabawę.

source_text: I’m the one who should apologize. You saw too much.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I’m the one who should apologize. You saw too much.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I’m the one who should apologize. You saw too much."

translation: To ja powinienem przeprosić. Za dużo zobaczyłaś.

source_text: Come on, Sister Judy. Let’s go inside and talk.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Come on, Sister Judy. Let’s go inside and talk.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Come on, Sister Judy. Let’s go inside and talk."

translation: Chodź, siostro Judy. Wejdźmy do środka i porozmawiajmy.

source_text: Are you going home, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Are you going home, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Are you going home, 1Hero?"

translation: Wracasz do domu, 1Hero?

source_text: Not yet. I’ve got some things to take care of.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Not yet. I’ve got some things to take care of.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Not yet. I’ve got some things to take care of."

translation: Jeszcze nie. Mam parę spraw do załatwienia.

source_text: Okay… I hope we can meet again soon.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Okay… I hope we can meet again soon.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Okay… I hope we can meet again soon."

translation: Dobrze… Mam nadzieję, że wkrótce znów się spotkamy.

source_text: I feel awful. What was I thinking?

structure.raw_value: McSaOp^.I feel awful. What was I thinking?
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp^.I feel awful. What was I thinking?"

translation: Czuję się okropnie. O czym ja myślałam?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I don’t know how long a cat would survive on your farm… I mean with all the coyotes in the forest.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I don’t know how long a cat would survive on your farm… I mean with all the coyotes in the forest."

translation: Nie wiem, jak długo kot przetrwałby na twojej farmie… No wiesz, przez te wszystkie kojoty w lesie.

source_text: It’s the circle of life, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.It’s the circle of life, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.It’s the circle of life, 1Hero."

translation: Takie jest koło życia, 1Hero.

source_text: Oh, God! No way!

structure.raw_value: ChWoClNo1.Oh, God! No way!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoClNo1.Oh, God! No way!"

translation: O Boże! Nie ma mowy!

source_text: I think we’ll manage.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.I think we’ll manage.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.I think we’ll manage."

translation: Myślę, że sobie poradzimy.

source_text: Good luck, Heather.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Good luck, Heather.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Good luck, Heather."

translation: Powodzenia, Heather.

source_text: Thanks for coming to our rescue, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Thanks for coming to our rescue, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Thanks for coming to our rescue, Carol."

translation: Dzięki, że przyszłaś nam na ratunek, Carol.

source_text: Behave, you two.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp>.Behave, you two.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp>.Behave, you two."

translation: Zachowujcie się, wy dwoje.

source_text: Thanks, 1Hero. You’re so helpful.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Thanks, 1Hero. You’re so helpful.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Thanks, 1Hero. You’re so helpful."

translation: Dzięki, 1Hero. Zawsze jesteś taki pomocny.

source_text: That’s me. Always happy to help.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.That’s me. Always happy to help.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.That’s me. Always happy to help."

translation: Cały ja. Zawsze chętnie pomogę.
